content.title: Genpact: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HAMILTON, Bermuda (AP) — Genpact Ltd. (G) on Thursday reported third-quarter net income of $145.8 million. The Hamilton, Bermuda-based company said it had profit of 83 cents per share. Earnings, adjusted for stock option expense and amortization costs, came to 97 cents per share.

content.title: Genpact (NYSE:G) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q3
content.summary: Business transformation services company Genpact (NYSE:G) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.6% year on year to $1.29 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $1.30 billion at the midpoint, 1.2% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.97 per share was 8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
